items.title: Rebecca Kilgore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: I just recorded another thing for Arbors with Dave Frishberg, Jackie Coon on flugelhorn and Eddie Erickson on guitar, and he and I do a few duets

ctx.x: What’s your next — do you have another recording project in mind?

Yes. There’s a local trio in Portland called Tall Jazz and they are made up of a vibes player, a drummer and a bass player and they all happen to be over six feet tall, so they call each other Tall Jazz. Cute. They’re all over six-two. And they’re extremely prolific. They’re great musicians and great businessmen, which, it doesn’t usually happen that way in combination. But I’m going to record something with them in 1998. And I just recorded with them a Christmas CD which will come out this December. And previous…
Working with a small record label, although they have a great reputation, do they pay you for the session, basically that’s it?
